course.title: Object Oriented Programming
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Mr. X is developing a software application to manage different types of products in (15) [CO3] a store. To achieve this, he decides to create a generic class named Product’ with two member variables product\_id’ which is an integer by default but can vary, and ‘product price’ which can be a floating point value representing the price. Now, design the generic ‘product’ class, including both a parameterized and a default constructor, to handle a wide range of product types and their respective prices.
